LEFT.description: Extracts a specified number of characters from the left side of a text string.

param.text: The text string to extract from

RIGHT.description: Extracts a specified number of characters from the right side of a text string.

param.text: The text string to extract from

LEN.description: Returns the number of characters in a text string.

UPPER.description: Converts a text string to uppercase.

LOWER.description: Converts a text string to lowercase.

TRIM.description: Removes leading and trailing spaces from a text string.

GREATEST.description: Returns the largest value from a set of numbers.

LEAST.description: Returns the smallest value from a set of numbers.

ROUND.description: Rounds a number to a specified number of decimal places.

CEIL.description: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer.

FLOOR.description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer.

ABS.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

param.number: The number to take the absolute value of

SQRT.description: Returns the square root of a number.

param.number: The number to take the square root of (must be >= 0)

SQRT.example: SQRT({area}), returns empty when the argument is negative

POWER.description: Returns the result of a number raised to a power.
POWER.example: POWER({side}, 2) calculates square; POWER(x, 0.5) is equivalent to square root

MOD.description: Returns the remainder of a division.

COALESCE.description: Returns the default value if the first argument is empty.

FORMAT_DATE.description: Formats a date value using a format string.
FORMAT_DATE.example: FORMAT_DATE(TODAY(), "YYYY-MM-DD") returns the current date, e.g. 2024-01-15

TODAY.example: TODAY() returns the current date, e.g. 2024-01-15

NOW.description: Returns the current date and time.
NOW.example: NOW() returns the current date and time, e.g. 2024-01-15 14:30:00

YEAR.description: Extracts the year from a date. Returns the current year if no argument is provided.

param.date: Date value (optional, defaults to current date)

YEAR.example: YEAR() or YEAR(TODAY()) returns the current year, e.g. 2024

MONTH.description: Extracts the month (1-12) from a date. Returns the current month if no argument is provided.

param.date: Date value (optional, defaults to current date)

MONTH.example: MONTH() or MONTH(TODAY()) returns the current month, e.g. 1

DAY.description: Extracts the day (1-31) from a date. Returns the current day if no argument is provided.

param.date: Date value (optional, defaults to current date)

DAY.example: DAY() or DAY(TODAY()) returns the current day, e.g. 15

DATEDIF.description: Calculates the difference between two dates.

param.unit: Unit ("Y" for years, "M" for months, "D" for days)

IF.description: Returns one value if a condition is true, and another value if it is false.

param.logical: Logical condition, an expression that evaluates to true or false
param.value1: Value returned when the condition is true
param.value2: Value returned when the condition is false

CASE.description: Evaluates conditions in order and returns the result of the first true condition. An optional default value can be specified.

param.default: Default value if no condition is met (optional)

AND.description: Returns true if all arguments are true; otherwise returns false.

OR.description: Returns true if any argument is true; otherwise returns false.

IS_BLANK.description: Checks whether a value is empty.

IS_ERROR.description: Checks whether a value is an error.
